description: One committed merge of the agents' branches: every file the merge touches, plus the reader's decision for each file that more than one agent changed. The request is the payload a conflict radar reports ONCE per merge action; the surface changes nothing itself. A file with a single agent's change needs no decision and is listed anyway, because the host has to merge it too — the request describes the whole merge, not only its conflicts. Resolutions carries exactly the reader's decisions; a conflicting file with no decision is a file the surface refuses to merge, so a request the host receives never leaves a conflict for it to discover itself.

members.name: ResolutionOf
members.description: The decision for one path, or null when the reader did not decide about it.

members.name: FileCount
members.description: How many files the merge touches.

members.name: Files
members.description: The paths the merge touches (conflict-free files included), in the order the surface shows them, with separators normalised to / and each path present once — a request that named one file twice would have the host merge it twice.

members.name: Resolutions
members.description: The reader's decisions, one per conflicting file.

members.name: ResolvedConflictCount
members.description: How many files the reader had to decide about.
